reviewMethod: Human semantic review of all 14 selected stored body figures from the fresh read-only evidence snapshot. Exact current-corpus DOI, task/page/article/source binding, original figure identity and caption, actual stored bytes and full SHA256, dimensions/type, duplicate and role risk, capture-report provenance, and rendered image content were checked. Five marked current-generation JACS files and nine older current-generation ACS files without the newer server marker were assessed from their DOI-bound Silverchair source paths, exact stored bytes and immutable capture-report chain; absence of the marker was not treated as approval. No publisher recrawl, R2/D1 mutation, direct import/repair, TOC reassignment, literature change or marker-only approval was used.
quality: All 14 approved files decoded/rendered and matched their owning paper and captions. Figure 1 entries remain body figures and are not treated as TOCs. Existing official TOCs are preserved. The 520 px PNG captures are accepted as readable stored evidence and are not represented as publisher-maximum resolution. No cross-DOI, recommendation-content, shared-byte, or same-ID replacement conflict was observed in this bounded subset.
